webdavDirectEdit.dialog.title: Open in Microsoft Office
webdavDirectEdit.dialog.hint: Make sure {0} is installed on this computer. The address is personal to you and expires, so do not share it.
webdavDirectEdit.dialog.lockHint: The document stays locked in Nuxeo while it is open. Close it in {0} to release the lock.
webdavDirectEdit.dialog.urlHint: You can also paste this address into {0} using File, then Open.
webdavDirectEdit.dialog.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it manually.
webdavDirectEdit.dialog.insecure: This server is not using HTTPS. On Windows, Microsoft Office refuses to send credentials over a plain HTTP connection unless the BasicAuthLevel registry value is changed. Ask your administrator to enable HTTPS.
webdavDirectEdit.credentials.intro: If Microsoft Office asks you to sign in, your session has expired or sign-in from the address is disabled. Use the user name and the token below.
webdavDirectEdit.credentials.token: Token, to be used as the password
webdavDirectEdit.credentials.warning: This token grants access to your Nuxeo account. Do not share it.
webdavDirectEdit.credentials.revoked: Token revoked. A new one will be issued the next time you need it.
webdavDirectEdit.credentials.failed: Could not get a sign-in token.
webdavDirectEdit.error.title: Cannot open this document
webdavDirectEdit.error.disabled: Opening documents in Microsoft Office is disabled on this server.
webdavDirectEdit.error.noBlob: This document has no file attached.
webdavDirectEdit.error.notEditable: This document cannot be modified. Versions, proxies and documents in the trash cannot be opened for editing.
webdavDirectEdit.error.notMainBlob: Only the main file of a document can be opened this way. Attachments are not reachable over WebDAV.
webdavDirectEdit.error.notOfficeFile: "{0}" is not a Microsoft Office document.
webdavDirectEdit.error.noWritePermission: You do not have permission to modify this document.
webdavDirectEdit.error.unknown: Something went wrong while preparing the document.
